messages:
Alex: Hi team — wrapping up laptop setup. Homebrew postinstall is prompting for an admin and MDM shows me as enrolled but not an admin. Anyone able to help with a safe temporary admin?
Jordan (IT): Welcome, Alex! Please paste the exact prompt or a screenshot. Also run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial` and paste the serial so I can look up your device.
Alex: Prompt: 'The operation requires administrator permission.' Serial: C02DEF5678YZ.
MDM-Bot: Device C02DEF5678YZ status: enrolled. Applied profile: "employee-standard". Admin group: none. Last check-in: 2026-03-01T14:03:12Z.
Jordan (IT): Looks like the standard profile landed. We can push a time-limited admin profile that expires (default 1h) or do a remote session where we run the exact commands. Which do you prefer?
Alex: Time-limited admin for 1 hour is easiest — I'm available now.
Toni: I recommend the temp profile so Alex can finish setup without a screened session.
Jordan (IT): Okay pushing temp-admin-1h. You'll get a macOS system prompt to accept a configuration profile. After accepting, run exactly once:
```
sudo dseditgroup -o edit -a alex -t user admin
```
Jordan (IT): After you've installed Homebrew and anything else, post here and I'll remove admin rights. Also verify FileVault is enabled and that the recovery key is escrowed by checking System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault.
Alex: Accepted the profile. Ran the dseditgroup command — installer resumed. Installed brew packages: zsh, git, aws-cli.
Sam: FYI, if you hit permissions issues on /opt/homebrew, try `sudo chown -R $(whoami) /opt/homebrew` once the admin is gone.
Alex: FileVault is ON and company escrow shows present.
Jordan (IT): Removing temp-admin now.
MDM-Bot: Profile update: temp-admin-1h removed for C02DEF5678YZ (performed by Jordan (IT)).
Alex: Confirmed I'm back to standard user. Everything works. Thanks for the quick turnaround! :tada:
Toni: Welcome again! Ping if you want my dotfiles or VS Code settings.
Jordan (IT): Logged internal ticket IT-4890 for the temporary admin action and FV confirmation. Closing loop — reopen if anything else crops up.
Alex: Appreciated, team!
